svg.title: Decoder-only attention block pipeline
svg.desc: Sequential flow from input embedding through Q/K/V projection, RoPE applied only to Q and K, head splitting, scaled dot-product attention with causal mask, softmax, weighted sum with V, and head merge with output projection.

g.text: Q = xWq, K = xWk, V = xWv
Applied to Q and K only, V untouched
